tasks.label: Phaselink: qmake + jom (Debug)
args: call "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Community\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat" && if not exist "${workspaceFolder}\build-debug" mkdir "${workspaceFolder}\build-debug" && cd /d "${workspaceFolder}\build-debug" && "C:\Qt\6.8.3\msvc2022_64\bin\qmake.exe" "${workspaceFolder}\Phaselink.pro" -spec win32-msvc CONFIG+=debug && "C:\Qt\Tools\QtCreator\bin\jom\jom.exe" -j%NUMBER_OF_PROCESSORS%
tasks.detail: 调用 vcvars64 后执行 qmake + jom，生成 Debug 版 Phaselink.exe

tasks.label: Phaselink: qmake + jom (Release)
